# `layout.enclosure.create_from_part`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/layout.enclosure.create_from_part.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`layout.enclosure.create_from_part` (`CreateEnclosureFromPart`, WP-S4.02 D7, FR-LAY-002): sets up a location's
enclosure from an enclosure part in one step.

`copies` (the `lib/` JSON form, as `device.place` takes them) are embedded first. Then, in order: the location's
layout space (created without a name when the location has none); the enclosure device, tag letter U with the
lowest counter `n ≥ 1` whose frozen tag `UC<n>` no device holds, frozen `UC<n>` (ruling 3: a page-less device is
never numbered), its location the given one and its function `function`, one piece of `part`; when the part's
enclosure section names a plate part, the plate device, a child of the enclosure device frozen `UC<n>-plate` with
one piece of the plate part and the same structure; then the enclosure and its plate surface exactly as
`layout.enclosure.create` makes them. One undo removes all of it, the embedded copies included.

Rejected: a location that does not exist or is not a location (`/location`, as `layout.space.create`); a part copy
the project does not hold after the embed (`/part`); a part without an enclosure section; a function node that
does not exist or is not a function (`/function`); a location that already has an enclosure; a plate part the
project does not hold. Interactive. Outcome: the new enclosure.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `copies` | array of any JSON value | no |  | The library documents to embed first (`lib/` JSON form): the enclosure part, its plate part and their closure; empty when the project holds them. |
| `function` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) or `null` | no |  | The function structure node of the enclosure device (the focused page's function). |
| `location` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | The location structure node (+J-E-2416). |
| `part` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | The enclosure part copy. |
| `pe_bond` | boolean or `null` | no |  | Whether the plate is bonded to protective earth; default false. |
| `pose` | [`CmdPose3`](#cmdpose3) or `null` | no |  | The enclosure's pose in the space; default the identity. |

## Types

### CmdPose3

A pose: the translation t = [x, y, z] in nanometres and the rotation q = [w, x, y, z], a sign-normalised unit quaternion in 10^-9 (doc 05 §3.2).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | array of (integer (min -2000000000, max 2000000000), integer (min -2000000000, max 2000000000), integer (min -2000000000, max 2000000000), integer (min -2000000000, max 2000000000)) (at least 4 item(s), at most 4 item(s)) | yes |  |  |
| `t` | array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 3 item(s), at most 3 item(s)) | yes |  |  |

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
